gloss: to put on glasses; to wear glasses

definitions.gloss: to put on glasses; to wear glasses
definitions.explanation: The standard expression for wearing eyeglasses. The verb かける (to hang, to put on) is used specifically for glasses, rather than つける or はめる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{眼鏡|めがね}をかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧にくく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}→老眼鏡：19227_rougankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Since small print became hard to see, I started wearing reading glasses.

notes:
The verb かける is the specific collocational partner for ⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧. This is one of the Japanese collocations that learners need to memorize, as the verb choice is not intuitive from English.

USAGE:
- {眼鏡|めがね}をかける: to put on / wear glasses
- {眼鏡|めがね}をかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be wearing glasses (habitual or current state)
- ⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off glasses (the opposite action)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦サングラス→サングラス：04535_sangurasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put on sunglasses
- ⟦{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}→老眼鏡：19227_rougankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put on reading glasses
- {眼鏡|めがね}をかけた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person wearing glasses

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧: to put on a hat (⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧ for head coverings)
- ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on a mask (⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ for masks)
- ⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめる: to put on gloves (はめる for fitted items)
